ruleDefinitions.name: Bypass UAC via WSReset.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects use of WSReset.exe to bypass User Account Control (UAC). Adversaries use this technique to execute privileged processes.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wsreset\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CONHOST\.EXE"))
